text:
## Range covered
The commits after v0.2.0 up to HEAD (5daf951): 3 commits. No tags left out.

## Release notes draft
### Features
- New `shout` command: prints your text in capital letters. (601002b)

### Fixes
- The greeting now ends with punctuation: "Hello, Ada!". (8d999d8)

### Other changes
- The README now describes the command-line tool. (5daf951)

## Grouping unsure
- 8d999d8 "fix: greet says Hello with punctuation": a change to what users see; put under Fixes, but it could be read as a new behaviour.
